Name: Junimo Bags
Author: slpOff
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Junimo Bag[/b][/size][/center]

Junimo Bag is a per-player storage bag. Store items in one place, browse them by category, use them for crafting, and connect them to chest logistics.


[size=5][b]Getting Started[/b][/size]

Buy the [b]Junimo Bag[/b] upgrade from the backpack upgrade line in Pierre's shop.

After purchase, a [b]Junimo Bag button[/b] appears in the inventory tab.


[size=5][b]Basic Use[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Left-click bag button[/b] - Open the Junimo Bag.[/*]
[*][b]Right-click bag button[/b] - Stash auto-stashable items into the bag.[/*]
[*][b]Move held item over bag button[/b] - Stash the held item into the bag.[/*]
[*][b]Open bag key[/b] - Open the Junimo Bag when no menu is open.[/*]
[*][b]Quick deposit key[/b] - Stash auto-stashable items into the Junimo Bag.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory pin key + item click[/b] - Pin or unpin an item so auto-stash ignores it.[/*]
[/list]
The [b]Quick Deposit[/b] key also works while the Junimo Bag menu is open. It stashes auto-stashable items from your player inventory.


[size=5][b]Browsing Items[/b][/size]

Items are grouped into categories such as:

[list]
[*]All[/*]
[*]Favorites[/*]
[*]Crafting[/*]
[*]Fish[/*]
[*]Seeds[/*]
[*]Resources[/*]
[/list]
Use the [b]search box[/b] to find items by ID or name.

Turn on the [b]owned-items filter[/b] to show only items currently stored in the bag.

Use the [b]quality button[/b] to switch between:

[list]
[*]Basic[/*]
[*]Silver[/*]
[*]Gold[/*]
[*]Iridium[/*]
[/list]
Turn on [b]all-quality stack view[/b] to combine counts across qualities.

When withdrawing items in this view, [b]right-click the button[/b] to choose which quality is withdrawn first.

The owned-items filter and all-quality stack view stay enabled when you close and reopen the Junimo Bag.


[size=5][b]Favorites And Pins[/b][/size]

Turn on the [b]star button[/b], then click items to add or remove favorites.

Turn on the [b]auto-stash exclusion button[/b], then click items to pin or unpin them.

Pinned items are marked with a [color=red]red outline[/color] and star badge in both:

[list]
[*]The inventory tab[/*]
[*]The player inventory area of the Junimo Bag menu[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Shipping Bin View[/b][/size]

Click the [b]shipping bin button[/b] in the Junimo Bag menu to switch the lower inventory area to the shipping bin.

While in this view, withdrawing a bag item sends it directly to the [b]shipping bin[/b] instead of your inventory.

Hover over the shipping bin button to see the [b]current total sell value[/b] of the shipping bin.


[size=5][b]Chest Logistics[/b][/size]

Chest menus include a [b]Junimo Bag logistics panel[/b].

For each chest, you can configure:

[list]
[*]Whether the chest is connected.[/*]
[*]Which player's Junimo Bag to use.[/*]
[*]Which items are supplied from the bag to the chest.[/*]
[*]Which items are retrieved from the chest to the bag.[/*]
[*]Minimum and maximum amounts kept in the chest.[/*]
[*]Minimum amount kept in the bag.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Crafting[/b][/size]

When crafting, ingredients stored in the Junimo Bag count if your player inventory is short.

Missing ingredients are automatically consumed from the Junimo Bag.

If [b]Better Crafting[/b] is installed, the Junimo Bag is registered as a material container.


[size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]

[b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] lets you change keybinds and display settings.

[list]
[*][b]Open Junimo Bag key[/b]
Key used to open the bag.
[/*]
[*][b]Quick deposit to Junimo Bag key[/b]
Key used to stash auto-stashable items.
[/*]
[*][b]Inventory pin key[/b]
Modifier key used to toggle auto-stash exclusions.
[/*]
[*][b]Pin last category[/b]
Reopen the Junimo Bag to the last selected category.
[/*]
[*][b]Selected category color[/b]
Text color used for the selected category.
[/*]
[*][b]Category order[/b]
Sort categories by entering numbers.
[/*]
[*][b]Category names[/b]
Set custom category display names.[/*]
[/list]
Lower category order numbers appear first.

Categories with the same number are sorted by name.


[size=5][b]Console Command[/b][/size]

[code]junimobag_give[/code]
Unlocks the Junimo Bag for the current player.
